ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) coverage on lateral lobes versus 30% low-intensity (black) coverage in the medial/peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity central region forming a 'W' shape extending from the notch toward the peduncle; high-intensity white fields cover the majority of the left and right lobes; high-frequency black mottling concentrated along the distal tips and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 115 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent jagged peaks and valleys localized on the distal half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges with a slight upward sweep terminating in tapered, rounded tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of low-intensity dark pixels on the white field at the far distal tips of both lobes; dense dark clustering on the terminal edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct dark linear mark on the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge; multiple faint vertical-aligned scratches on the left lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jagged notches along the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting previous tissue loss or mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical central pigmentation pattern resembling a stylized avian silhouette centered on the median notch.
